public_rationale: The Nature Neuroscience paper published September 14, 2026 reports simultaneous speech and gesture decoding for avatar control in people with paralysis [e1]. The accessible record does not establish when this capability was achieved relative to July 28, 2026 or demonstrate substantial, reproducible practical gains over that baseline [e1]. The study therefore does not meet the contract's early-resolution rule for support [e1].
limitations: The forecast supplies no deadline or numerical threshold for great improvement.
Publication after the forecast does not establish achievement after it [e1].
Comparable July 2026 baseline measurements and independent replication are missing from the accessible evidence [e1].
The study does not establish whether or when Kurzweil's broader vision will be reached [e1].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Brain-computer interfaces will improve greatly, though reaching Kurzweil's vision may take many decades or centuries.

statement.excerpt: Brain-computer interfaces will surely improve greatly (though it may take many decades or even centuries to get where Kurzweil dreams of).
statement.document_title: Sorry, Sam and Elon, we have not reached the Singularity

from_speaker: may take many decades or even centuries
our_interpretation: Great improvement means substantial, documented gains in useful BCI capability relative to the July 28, 2026 baseline, such as communication, control, reliability or practical usability.
No numerical improvement threshold is supplied; no arbitrary percentage is imposed.
The parenthetical permits a long wait for Kurzweil's vision. It does not promise that vision by a particular date or require all meaningful improvements to wait decades.
A small study or new publication does not automatically establish a substantial advance over capabilities already achieved before the post.
criteria.support_condition: Dated, independently validated results establish substantial practical capability gains beyond the July 2026 baseline.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No finite interval of slow progress contradicts this forecast without a deadline. Contradiction would require compelling evidence that the promised substantial improvement cannot occur.

evidence.explanation: The study reports simultaneous speech and gesture control of an avatar, including functional demonstrations in two participants. The accessible record does not establish that the achievement occurred after July 28 or provide the validated July-baseline comparison required for early resolution.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A dated post-July 28, 2026 demonstration of substantial practical BCI gains over the July 2026 baseline, independently validated and reproduced with comparable measurements. Contradiction would require compelling evidence that such improvement cannot occur; slow progress over a finite period would not suffice.
